info.name: loanDolphin API Tests
info.description:
API tests for the loanDolphin backend (Express + MongoDB).

HOW TO RUN: start MongoDB and the backend (port 5000), pick the "loanDolphin Local" environment, then run the WHOLE collection in order (Collection Runner, or `newman run loanDolphin.postman_collection.json -e loanDolphin.local.postman_environment.json`). Requests depend on each other (branches -> customer -> accounts -> loans), so single requests will not work in isolation.

AUTH: the API uses an httpOnly JWT cookie. Postman and newman keep it in their cookie jar automatically; the collection logs in and out as admin, customer and branch manager as needed.

RATE LIMIT: /users/login, /users/register and POST /customer/loans share one limiter (10 requests per 15 minutes per IP). One full run uses 10 requests. Run it again only after restarting the backend or waiting 15 minutes. The first request that hits the limiter checks this and fails with a clear test name if the window is already used up.

DATA: every run creates uniquely named branches, managers and a customer (suffix {{runId}}), so reruns never clash with existing data. The seeded admin account (admin / admin123) must exist.
